jobDescription: Signalling equipment on the network is replaced in possessions taken at night and at weekends, and the renewals project manager cannot be at three sites at once. The Project Coordinator is the manager's second pair of hands: the possession plan and the works schedule are kept current by the coordinator, the possession briefings and the site access permits are recorded by the coordinator, the infrastructure owner's representative receives the coordinator's weekly progress report, equipment deliveries are tracked by the coordinator against the schedule, and every commissioning stage ends with the coordinator's hand-over note. Possession decisions and commissioning sign-off remain with the project manager and the commissioning engineer. Reports to the renewals project manager; works with the signalling contractor, the possession planners and the infrastructure owner's representative.
requirements: Keeps the possession plan and the works schedule current with the contractor's progress.
Records possession briefings and site access permits under the programme's procedures.
Prepares the weekly progress report for the infrastructure owner's representative.
Tracks equipment deliveries against the schedule, with possession decisions staying with the project manager, and records own responsibility boundaries.
Writes the hand-over note at each commissioning stage.

evidence.text: Three years as project coordinator on a signalling renewals programme for a signalling contractor: the possession plan and the works schedule for three renewal sites were mine to keep current each week from the contractor's reported progress.

The possession briefings and the site access permits on the three sites were recorded by me under the programme's procedures; the infrastructure owner audited the records twice and raised no findings.
The infrastructure owner's representative received my weekly progress report on each site, and the reports with the representative's comments are in the programme folder.

Equipment deliveries were tracked by me against the schedule in the delivery log, which marks the delivery queries I settled with the suppliers and the ones that needed the project manager's possession decision.
Each commissioning stage on the three sites ended with my hand-over note, countersigned by the commissioning engineer.

Work sample: a month of possession plan updates, a possession briefing record, a weekly progress report and a commissioning stage hand-over note, with the programme folder references as a verification trail.

Reference call with the former renewals project manager: confirmed the candidate kept the plans and the records in the period, with possession decisions and commissioning sign-off remaining with the manager and the commissioning engineer, and confirmed the dates.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate holds the required track safety card and can attend the site induction next week; no relocation needed.

gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the decision boundary as documented: plans and records by the candidate, possession decisions and commissioning sign-off by the project manager and the commissioning engineer; the packet makes no judgement.
